one_concrete_rival.source_description: I.3 derives a named paint from a base; I.4–6 introduce other preparations. I.7 explicitly resumes the earlier I.3 recipe despite those intervening preparations. I.8 applies modified paint so earlier paint remains visible above and below. The named regions include faces and hands of painted figures, so body-region vocabulary need not describe a living medical patient.
